persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayabhūpatīndra malla mahārājā(5)dhirājana māghayā yāyayātā dayakase bijyāṅā juro

purpose: śrīśrībhavānī prītirastu / māghayā yāyayātā dayakase bijyāṅā
notes: The scribe is unnamed; only the standard scribal excuse verse (yathā dṛṣṭaṃ tathā likhitaṃ...) is included. Bhaktapur as place of copying is given by the catalogue based on King Bhūpatīndra Malla's kingdom, but is not explicitly named in the colophon.
